'''Bandin Dobah's asteroid base''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] located in [[The Pit/Legends|the Pit]], an area of stray asteroids scattered throughout the arm of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] and located at the end of the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]]. It served as [[Bandin Dobah]]'s base in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was composed of a hangar and three caves dug by [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]]: one with [[Godon Netakka]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]], another full of [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]], and the last with the [[Vagrant (freighter)|''Vagrant'']], Dobah's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and holdout.
